title: Obsidian Sync Latency Outlier
app: Obsidian Sync, Todoist, Toggl Track, Google Calendar / iCloud calendar exports, and task metadata ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=obsidian:sync
| stats avg(sync_duration_ms) as avg_sync_duration_ms, max(sync_duration_ms) as max_sync_duration_ms by vault device
| where avg_sync_duration_ms>3000 OR max_sync_duration_ms>10000
| sort - avg_sync_duration_ms
description: Uses Obsidian Sync timing telemetry to monitor how long sync operations are taking by device in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for vaults or clients that feel sluggish to sync, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Obsidian Sync timing data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Vault and device table of sync latency.
grandmaExplanation: It turns how long sync operations are taking by device so you can spot vaults or clients that feel sluggish to sync before it becomes annoying.
